features.description: Exact variant key count (73), range (E1-E7), white/black pattern, and geometry.
Six ordered sections at documented widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, continuous chassis.
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program/Synth as the only primary OLEDs.
Pointer/touch/keyboard key press, release, and cancel/blur behavior.
Every visible control moves or presses accessibly and changes presentation state only.
Accessible names, roles, values, keyboard operation, and visible focus.
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, node cleanup.
Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/sustain, and denied/disconnected MIDI.
Sustain transitions, concurrent voices, deterministic stealing, velocity response.
Truthful loading/ready/error/fallback status; blur/disconnect/unmount stops every owned voice.
No marketing hero, detached rails, missing keys, overflow, or clipped chassis at 1440x900 and 390x844.

Six selectable types; Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets that load offline and render audibly distinct signals; Clav/Digital/Misc are honest synthesis; labeled playable fallback on asset failure.
Two layers (A, B) with enable, focus, level, and octave shift and correct per-layer voice ownership; disabled layers produce no voices.
KB Touch (3 curves), Dyn Comp (Off/1/2/3), Timbre, Unison (Off/1/2/3), and Soft Release each measurably change rendered audio.
Sustain from the engine API (UI/keyboard/MIDI CC64) holds released notes until the pedal lifts and only affects layers with SUSTPED on.
When sample assets fail to load the engine enters a labeled playable fallback that still renders sound (synthesized), never claiming recordings it lacks.
One AudioContext feeds layer buses, ordered effect units, master gain/limiter, and one destination; master level scales loudness; dispose cleans up all voices.
Focus follows/overrides layer focus, Piano group mode, Delay/Compressor/Reverb global mode, per-unit bypass, all-effects bypass, documented signal order, and To Rotary routing (reverb before rotary).
Each effect unit and every listed type processes real audio and is audibly distinct, with working bypass and dry/wet; delay feedback filtering processes the repeats.
The Phase 1 surface, keybed, inputs, accessibility, and console cleanliness remain intact under the Phase 2 AudioEngine.
